distractors.option: Mia misses the week which she spent spring break at the lake cabin where she painted pictures each morning.
distractors.reason: Using 'which' for a time noun instead of 'when' is a very common grade 7 error, and the correct 'where' later makes the sentence look polished.

distractors.option: Mia misses the week when she spent spring break at the lake cabin which she painted pictures each morning.
distractors.reason: 'Cabin which' sounds natural because 'which' usually follows a thing noun; students often miss that the clause has no gap and needs 'where'.

distractors.option: Mia misses the week which she spent spring break at the lake cabin which she painted pictures each morning.
distractors.reason: A student who treats 'which' as the all-purpose relative pronoun after any noun would choose this one, and it reads smoothly at speed.
